facts: sBrOILER ROOMS and end-of-term parties are SBR Ents events.
Party announcements go out by e-mail and on Instagram @samuelsroom.
Port & Sherry: in the SBR after hall on Fridays, GBP1.50 a glass.
BA Table: Tuesdays and Fridays in term. Tickets on UPay, and they sell out.
The SBR room is at I2, First Court.
The SBR room has a TV with a Wii, board games, a pool table, a piano and a small kitchen.
The Samuel Butler Room Society was founded in 1960.
Samuel Butler studied at St John's from 1854 to 1858.
Every master's and PhD student at St John's is automatically an SBR member.
The SBR committee is elected every year and organises events all year round.
